items.title: UQPAY Deploys Visa Payment Passkey, Advancing the Next Generation of Agentic Payment Experience
items.summary: UQPAY has announced the production deployment of Visa Payment Passkey, becoming one of the earlier issuers in Asia Pacific to bring this capability into a live environment. It marks another step forward in UQPAY's work on payment security, user experience, and the foundations of intelligent commerce.
